$comment: Every secret a stack needs. owner=generated: minted by the bootstrap (random) into the stack's store — the GitHub environment for nas, the local store for lcl. owner=operator: entered ONCE in the setup wizard, which copies it into every GitHub environment that needs it. owner=module: written back by a module (logto, glitchtip) after it ran — never minted, not required before that. scope=platform lives in <platform>-shared AND is mirrored into every <platform>-<env> of that platform (a job sees one environment); scope=env lives in <platform>-<env>; scope=stack is minted per stack (the shared stack too); scope=wizard never leaves the wizard's own store. platforms: absent = every platform. feature: only needed when the environment enables it (features in infra/platforms/<platform>/envs/<env>.json). Variables (VITE_*, NATIVE_*) are not secrets and are written back by the modules directly.

secrets.name: PLATFORM_DOMAIN
secrets.rotation: the platform's domain (Synology DDNS) — kept out of the public repo

secrets.name: SYNOLOGY_URL
secrets.rotation: DSM base url as GitHub reaches it, e.g. https://<domain>:5001

secrets.name: SYNOLOGY_USER
secrets.rotation: the deploy account: a DSM administrator with DSM + File Station allowed, 2FA off

secrets.name: SYNOLOGY_PASS
secrets.rotation: that account's password

secrets.name: SYNOLOGY_PATH
secrets.rotation: the File Station folder bundles land in (platform.json publishedPath); the live dir is its parent

secrets.name: ACME_EMAIL
secrets.rotation: Let's Encrypt contact for the wildcard certificate DSM requests; defaults to admin@<domain>

secrets.name: GHCR_PAT
secrets.rotation: only for PRIVATE images — the munni images are public and pull anonymously

secrets.name: GLITCHTIP_SECRET_KEY
secrets.rotation: GlitchTip's Django SECRET_KEY; rotating invalidates its sessions

secrets.name: GLITCHTIP_ADMIN_PASSWORD
secrets.rotation: the GlitchTip admin's password (admin@munni.<platform>) — created inside the container by the shared stack's deploy; also in the platform's vault

secrets.name: GLITCHTIP_API_TOKEN
secrets.rotation: GlitchTip API token (40 hex) created inside the container by the shared stack's deploy; the bootstrap creates the org/projects and writes the DSNs back with it

secrets.name: GLITCHTIP_EMAIL_URL
secrets.rotation: SMTP url for crash-report mails; consolemail:// when absent

secrets.name: PGADMIN_PASSWORD
secrets.rotation: pgAdmin's login (admin@munni.dev)

secrets.name: VAULT_ADMIN_EMAIL
secrets.rotation: the platform's Vaultwarden account — the wizard generates it; every credential the setup mints is kept there

secrets.name: VAULT_MASTER_PASSWORD
secrets.rotation: that account's master password — generated by the wizard, shown under Reveal secrets

secrets.name: VAULT_SIGNUPS_ALLOWED
secrets.rotation: empty = registration open (first account); false once the platform's account exists

secrets.name: CONTROL_LOGTO_APP_ID
secrets.rotation: the control cockpit's Logto app id, registered in the control environment's Logto

secrets.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
secrets.rotation: one per Postgres server: every environment's own, and the shared stack's (GlitchTip's database)

secrets.name: LOGTO_INFRA_M2M_ID
secrets.rotation: the environment's Logto machine credential (Management API) — seeded into Logto's database by the environment's first deploy; rotating re-seeds

secrets.name: LOGTO_INFRA_M2M_SECRET
secrets.rotation: see LOGTO_INFRA_M2M_ID

secrets.name: LOGTO_ADMIN_M2M_ID
secrets.rotation: the admin-tenant machine credential that claims the console's first admin — seeded like the infra one

secrets.name: LOGTO_ADMIN_M2M_SECRET
secrets.rotation: see LOGTO_ADMIN_M2M_ID

secrets.name: LOGTO_CONSOLE_USERNAME
secrets.rotation: the Logto console's admin, created by the bootstrap; also in the vault

secrets.name: LOGTO_CONSOLE_PASSWORD
secrets.rotation: see LOGTO_CONSOLE_USERNAME

secrets.name: LOGTO_M2M_APP_ID
secrets.rotation: the api's own machine-to-machine Logto app, written back after the apps are created

secrets.name: LOGTO_M2M_APP_SECRET
secrets.rotation: see LOGTO_M2M_APP_ID

secrets.name: API_SENTRY_DSN
secrets.rotation: the api's crash-report DSN, written back by the glitchtip module

secrets.name: PUSH_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY
secrets.rotation: never casually — replacing the pair kills existing web-push subscriptions

secrets.name: PUSH_VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.rotation: paired with the public key

secrets.name: GOCARDLESS_SECRET_ID
secrets.rotation: GoCardless Bank Account Data portal

secrets.name: GOCARDLESS_SECRET_KEY
secrets.rotation: GoCardless Bank Account Data portal

secrets.name: ENABLEBANKING_APPLICATION_ID
secrets.rotation: Enable Banking portal

secrets.name: ENABLEBANKING_PRIVATE_KEY_PEM
secrets.rotation: Enable Banking portal (downloadable once)

secrets.name: FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON
secrets.rotation: Firebase service account JSON — the api sends native push with it

secrets.name: LOGODEV_SECRET_KEY
secrets.rotation: logo.dev dashboard

secrets.name: LOGODEV_PUBLIC_TOKEN
secrets.rotation: logo.dev dashboard

secrets.name: LOGTO_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
secrets.rotation: Google Cloud console OAuth client

secrets.name: LOGTO_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.rotation: Google Cloud console OAuth client

secrets.name: LOGTO_APPLE_CLIENT_ID
secrets.rotation: Apple Services ID

secrets.name: LOGTO_APPLE_TEAM_ID
secrets.rotation: Apple developer team

secrets.name: LOGTO_APPLE_KEY_ID
secrets.rotation: Sign in with Apple key

secrets.name: LOGTO_APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.rotation: Sign in with Apple key (.p8)

secrets.name: PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON
secrets.rotation: Play Console → API access: service-account JSON with release permission

secrets.name: ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64
secrets.rotation: the upload keystore (base64) — minted once by the wizard; Play pins the first upload key per package

secrets.name: ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD

secrets.name: ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS
secrets.rotation: minted with the keystore (munni-upload)

secrets.name: ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD

secrets.name: ASC_ISSUER_ID

secrets.name: ASC_KEY_P8

secrets.name: APPLE_TEAM_ID

secrets.rotation: fine-grained PAT for THIS repo: Administration RW + Secrets RW + Variables RW + Actions RW + Contents RW — the wizard stores secrets, commits platform config and dispatches workflows with it; never leaves the wizard's store
